<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-docs` from the `mt_export` registry. Do not edit. -->

How exports work: [Exporting recordings](/docs/exporting-recordings/). Pass options with `--opt KEY=VALUE`; defaults for some come from `[recording.export]`.

## `cast` — asciicast (.cast)

Default extension: `.cast`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trim_start` | float 0–1000000 | `0` | Drop this many seconds from the start |
| `trim_end` | float 0–1000000 | `0` | Drop this many seconds from the end |
| `idle_limit` | float 0–1000000 | `0` | Cap pauses at this many seconds (0 = off) |
| `strip_input` | bool | `true` | Drop keystroke events so a shared file does not leak them |
| `title` | text | `` | Replace the title in the header (empty = keep) |

## `vhs` — VHS tape (.tape)

Default extension: `.tape`. Needs a recording made with input (`capture_input` or `--input`).

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type_gap_ms` | int 1–5000 | `150` | Keys closer than this become one Type |
| `min_sleep_ms` | int 0–60000 | `400` | Shorter gaps emit no Sleep |
| `sleep_cap_ms` | int 0–600000 | `3000` | Longest Sleep emitted |
| `font_size` | int 6–96 | `14` | Set FontSize in the tape header |
| `output` | text | `demo.gif` | Name of the file the tape asks VHS to write |
